latest.headline: Anthropic's $83 pricing lifts MU 4.8% pre-market to $739
latest.tldr: MU closed Wednesday at $705.27 (−1.00%), last printed $738.82 (+4.76%) at 7:21 ET after Anthropic priced above its range, and I expect an open about 2% to 6% higher (roughly $719–$748), with a centre near +4% because the last three opens landed 1.0 to 1.6 points under the early print.
